function.name: get_order_status
function.description: Live status of a JOOLA web order from the store: payment status, fulfilment status, items, shipments with carrier, tracking number and tracking link, and any returns. Use this (not lookup_order) whenever the customer asks where their order is, whether it shipped, about delivery, tracking, or a return — including 'can you check my order 5301'. Ask for the order number OR the email address used on the order — either one is enough; do not ask for both and never ask for a ZIP or postcode. Call the tool as soon as you have one of them. Returns { enabled, status, order, other_orders }. status 'ok': give the status in plain words; read a tracking number only if asked, and offer to email the tracking link. If the lookup was by email and other_orders is not empty, say which order you found (its order number and date) and ask if they meant that one or one of the others. 'not_found': say you couldn't find an order with that number (or for that email) and ask them to check it once, or offer to try the other detail. 'invalid_order_number': ask them to repeat the order number (it has 3 or more digits, e.g. 5301). 'invalid_email': ask them to spell the email address again. 'needs_order_number_or_email': ask for the order number or the email on the order. If enabled is false or status is 'unavailable' or 'disabled', use lookup_order instead, or offer to have the team follow up by email. Never read out addresses, emails or payment details.

order_number.description: The order number as the customer said it, e.g. '5301' or '#5301'. Leave empty if they only gave an email.

email.description: Email address used on the order, if the customer gave it instead of (or as well as) the order number.
